an6.98:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] so vata bhikkhave bhikkhu kañci saṅkhāraṃ niccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:1.2: anulomikāya khantiyā asamannāgato, sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:1.3: sammattaniyāmaṃ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:2.1: so vata bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbasaṅkhāraṃ aniccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatī’ti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:2.2: anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:2.3: sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti.
